descr.entity: The weather entity is required and should be from the SwissWeather integration. If another weather entity is used, not all data may be displayed correctly.
descr.show_location: Show the location name above the current weather
descr.sun_entity: The sun entity is required to display sunrise and sunset times.
descr.wind_entity: The wind entity is required to display wind speed.
descr.wind_direction_entity: The wind direction entity is required to display wind direction.
descr.sunshine_entity: The sunshine entity is required to display sunshine duration.
descr.precipitation_entity: The precipitation entity is required to display the precipitation forecast.
descr.show_forecast: Toggle the weather forecast section on or off. The forecast shows up to 7 days depending on what the weather service provides.
descr.show_temperature: Show the temperature chart with the forecast based on the set hours
descr.show_precipitation: Show the precipitation chart with the forecast based on the set hours
descr.show_sunshine: Show the sunshine duration chart with the forecast based on the set hours
descr.show_wind: Show the wind chart with the forecast based on the set hours
descr.enable_animate_weather_icons: Show animated icons. If disabled, static icons are displayed.
descr.compact_mode: In compact mode, fewer details are displayed for the daily forecast and current data (e.g. wind direction)
descr.forecast_hours: Number of hours to show in the hourly forecast (default: 6, maximum 18)

descr.show_warnings: Show weather warnings if the weather warning entity is set and the actual warning exists.
descr.warning_entity: Legacy: The weather warnings entity created by the original SwissWeather integration (izacus/hass-swissweather). Ignored when the ranked warning entities below are configured.
descr.primary_warning_entity: Primary weather warning entity (*_primary_weather_warning) from mastameista/hass-swissweather. When set, the new ranked model is activated.
descr.secondary_warning_entity: Secondary weather warning entity (*_secondary_weather_warning) from mastameista/hass-swissweather.
descr.tertiary_warning_entity: Tertiary weather warning entity (*_tertiary_weather_warning) from mastameista/hass-swissweather.
